sections.heading: HOD,Electronics and Communication Engg. Dept.(Advanced Communication Technology)
sections.content:
Electronics and Communication Engineering (Advance Communication Technology) department is started for the A.Y 2023-24 as a First Batch entered into the stream .The department is following all norms by governing bodies of AICTE ,DTE under the guidance of SPPU. The sanction intake for this branch 60 and DTE Code 679492810 At its core, the purpose of the Advanced Communication Technology branch is to prepare graduates to meet the ever-increasing demand for sophisticated communication solutions. With the exponential growth in data generation, the proliferation of mobile devices, and the expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT), there is a pressing need for experts who can design, implement, and manage advanced communication systems. The program focuses on equipping students with a deep understanding of both the theoretical principles and practical applications of communication technologies, ensuring they can tackle complex challenges and develop innovative solutions. The objective of the department is to produce engineering graduates with academic excellence, positive attitude, good communication and technical skills enriched with self-confidence. This will help them for easy employment as well as for further higher studies in India or abroad. One of the primary objectives of the program is to provide students with a comprehensive education in the latest advancements in communication technology. This includes mastering the intricacies of wireless networks, satellite communications, optical fiber technology, and next-generation mobile networks such as 5G etc. By offering a curriculum that integrates cutting-edge research with practical skills, the program ensures that graduates are well-versed in the most current and emerging technologies. This focus on up-to-date knowledge prepares students to contribute effectively to the development and optimization of communication systems that are essential for various applications, from personal communication to global business operations. Furthermore, the program aims to enhance students’ problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. As communication systems become increasingly complex, the ability to analyze and address intricate technical issues is vital. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on experience and real-world problem- solving, enabling students to work on projects that simulate actual industry challenges. This practical approach not only solidifies their technical expertise but also fosters the development of innovative solutions that can be applied in professional settings. In addition to technical proficiency, the Advanced Communication Technology program prioritizes the development of professional skills essential for career success. Effective communication, teamwork, and leadership are integral components of the curriculum. Graduates are trained to communicate complex technical information clearly and to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, ensuring they can thrive in diverse work environments. This focus on soft skills complements their technical education, preparing them for roles that require both technical acumen and strong interpersonal abilities. Another key aspect of the program’s purpose is to foster a commitment to ethical practice and regulatory compliance. As communication technologies impact various aspects of society, from privacy and security to legal and regulatory considerations, it is crucial for professionals in this field to uphold high ethical standards. The program incorporates training on the ethical implications of communication technology and the importance of adhering to industry regulations, ensuring that graduates understand and address the broader societal impacts of their work. Finally, the Advanced Communication Technology program is designed to instill a passion for lifelong learning and professional development. The field of communication technology is characterized by rapid innovation and change, necessitating a continuous commitment to staying current with emerging trends and advancements. The program encourages students to engage in ongoing learning and professional growth, equipping them with the skills and mindset needed to adapt to evolving technological landscapes and to lead future innovations. In summary, the Advanced Communication Technology branch is dedicated to preparing students for a challenging and rewarding career in a rapidly evolving field. By providing a robust education in advanced communication technologies, enhancing problem-solving and professional skills, promoting ethical practice, and encouraging lifelong learning, the program fulfills its purpose of developing highly skilled professionals who are well-equipped to address the complex and dynamic needs of the global communication industry.

Nature Of Programme | Full Time
Duration | 4 Year
